sb_prompt: PLEASE DISCUSS TYPES OF VACATIONS AND TRIPS YOU ENJOY.  FIND OUT WHETHER THE OTHER CALLER CAN INTEREST YOU IN A VACATION SPOT YOU HAVEN'T VISITED.
raw_output:
ParticipantA: What kind of vacations do you usually go on?
ParticipantB: I like to go on road trips and visit different states.
ParticipantA: I prefer going to the beach and soaking up the sun.
ParticipantB: That sounds nice. I have a friend who loves going to the beach, but I prefer cooler climates.
ParticipantA: Have you ever been to any cooler places?
ParticipantB: Yeah, I've been to a few national parks. I love the mountains.
ParticipantA: That's awesome. I've never been to any national parks, but I've heard they're beautiful.
ParticipantB: Definitely. Have you been on any international vacations?
ParticipantA: No, I haven't. I would love to go to Europe one day.
ParticipantB: That's a great destination. I've been to France and it's amazing.
ParticipantA: Oh, I'd love to go to France. What was your favorite thing to do there?
ParticipantB: I loved the food and the history. The architecture is amazing.
ParticipantA: That sounds great. I'm more of a beach person, but I can appreciate the history and culture of other places.
ParticipantB: Yeah, there's so much to see and do in the world. It's hard to choose just one place to go to.
ParticipantA: Definitely. Have you ever been to any other countries?
ParticipantB: Yeah, I've been to Canada and Mexico.
ParticipantA: Oh, cool. I've heard Canada is beautiful. Have you been to any other Canadian provinces besides Quebec?
ParticipantB: No, just Quebec. I would love to visit the Rockies one day.
ParticipantA: Yeah, the Rockies are amazing. I've been to Banff and it was breathtaking.
ParticipantB: That sounds amazing. Have you been on any cruises?
ParticipantA: No, I haven't. I've heard they can be fun, but I'm not a big fan of being on a boat for too long.
ParticipantB: Yeah, they can be fun, but they're not for everyone. Have you been on any other types of vacations besides beach and road trips?
ParticipantA: No, those are my favorites. I've been to a few big cities, but I prefer to stay in one place when I'm on vacation.
ParticipantB: Yeah, I get that. I like to move around and see different places.
ParticipantA: Well, it was nice talking to you.
ParticipantB: Yeah, you too. Have a great day.
